interface.longDescription: Ocean Liner GPT helps readers explore historic passenger ships and material culture using evidence-first instructions, reference documents, and a read-only connection to OceanLiners.net. Search published index titles and descriptions, then retrieve current article text and listed source links. Retrieved archive content is not independent verification, and listed sources are not automatically read. It does not authenticate objects, certify provenance, provide appraisals or market advice, or edit the archive. OpenAI account and usage conditions apply.

name: ocean-liner-gpt-live
description: Ocean Liner GPT provides evidence-first exploration of historic passenger ships and their material culture. Grounded in maritime scholarship and curatorial standards, it explains historical context, survivability of artifacts, and the limits of attribution—prioritizing clarity over certainty.
